story.originalTitle: "I've always loved Interlagos. It's a fast, flowing, old-school racetrack, and the Brazilian fans are incredibly passionate about their racing." A wor...
story.summaryEn:
"I've always loved Interlagos. It's a fast, flowing, old-school racetrack, and the Brazilian fans are incredibly passionate about their racing."
A world title, words of wisdom and a ladder best avoided. @JensonButton reflects in his final journal entry of the season.
Read it here: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/jensons-journal-entry-05
detailZh:
“我一直喜欢Interlagos。这是一条快速、流畅、复古的赛道，巴西的粉丝对赛车运动充满热情。”
世界冠军、智慧的话语和最好避免的梯子。@JensonButton在赛季最后的日记中反思。
阅读这里：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/jensons-journal-entry-05
detailEn:
"I've always loved Interlagos. It's a fast, flowing, old-school racetrack, and the Brazilian fans are incredibly passionate about their racing."
A world title, words of wisdom and a ladder best avoided. @JensonButton reflects in his final journal entry of the season.
Read it here: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/jensons-journal-entry-05
